answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The inlet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the vault is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
